Shining Force Gaiden II - Jashin no Kaku.name: Shining Force: The Sword of Hajya
Shining Force Gaiden II - Jashin no Kaku.summary: The peaceful kingdom of Cypress has suddenly been disrupted by the corrupt ambition of the evil King Iom. Terror rampages across the land. The Castle of Cypress is invaded and the magical Sword of Hajya is taken! It will take strength, courage, agility and your keen sense of strategy to defy this ominous power.
